description: This PHP script handles incoming email checks in the SuiteCRM project. It manages different email retrieval modes ('personal' and 'group') by interacting with the BeanFactory to manage inbound email beans and importing messages accordingly. It also performs redirect operations based on the email type.

classes.name: InboundEmail
classes.description: Class representing inbound email configuration and operations within SuiteCRM. It includes methods for retrieving email configurations and importing email messages.

methods.name: importMessages
methods.description: Method in InboundEmail class that imports email messages from the configured inbound email account.
